messages.subject: Project Falcon - completion accounts query
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

On Project Falcon (Bracken / Greaves Precision), my client has a query on the completion accounts - specifically the treatment of the £1m earn-out reserve against the working-capital adjustment. Could one of your corporate team give Amelia a call this week? I appreciate this isn't your matter but you were copied on the original heads of terms.

Best,
Jonathan Vane
Castle & Vane LLP
